newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam Jan-Nov industry output up yr-yr 13.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam Jan-Nov industry output up yr-yr 13.8 pct.

text.p: Vietnam's industrial output rose 13.8 percent in January-November this year from the same period in 1995, the Government Statistics Office said on Wednesday.
Industrial output in November alone was 16.7 percent higher than in the same month last year.
Industrial output in the first 10 months of the year was up 13.5 percent from the same period a year earlier.

The statistics office's figures showed that state-sector output rose by a year-on-year 12.0 percent in the January-November period, non-state sector output by 12.6 percent and the foreign-invested sector output by 19.8 percent.

Earlier, the statistics office said Vietnam had posted a record trade deficit of $3.591 billion in the period from January 1 to November 15. It said the cumulative deficit had widening from $3.35 billion in the first 9-1/2 months of the year.
